focus: Static review of parity mask equality and counts, RGB-channel threshold interpretation, and malformed/truncated image buffers.

inspected.scope: StudyImage, fromComputeRGBA and ReferenceStudyRenderer mask production, lines 375–407 and 481–533

checks.method: Manual source comparison to m02-m03-code-v2 rendering gate
checks.result: StudyParityMetrics uses mean absolute RGB-channel error <= 1 and fraction of RGB channels with error strictly > 4 <= 0.005; denominator is 3 * pixelCount and alpha is excluded. Maximum error is diagnostic for these six parity fixtures, consistent with the separate maximum <= 1 precision-harness requirement.

Both masks must contain exactly pixelCount binary bytes and their population must equal the bounded unsupportedPixels value. The pass predicate requires exact per-position mask equality and count equality. Equal aggregate unsupported counts cannot hide swapped invalid pixels.

Positive identical dimensions, checked pixel and RGBA-size multiplication, and exact byte counts are required before buffer iteration. Thus equally truncated/extended images, empty data, mismatched row layouts, and overflow dimensions are rejected rather than receiving a false parity pass.

fromComputeRGBA bounds dimensions before multiplication, requires the exact packed RGBA length, accepts alpha 0 only with diagnostic magenta RGB, restores opaque alpha and retains a separate invalid mask. Opaque magenta is not inferred to be invalid. Parity requires alpha 255 for every display pixel.

ReferenceStudyRenderer starts with a zero mask, increments the count and corresponding mask byte in the invalid-surface branch, and returns both. Tests inspect sphere and portrait output count/mask consistency and diagnostic magenta, but were not executed here.

Source covers identical images, swapped flags, valid opaque magenta, sparse maximum error, malformed buffers, invalid/overflow dimensions, missing/short/long/nonbinary/inconsistent masks, nonopaque alpha, and renderer mask retention. No test execution is claimed.

limitations: Host execution was unavailable. No Swift tests, build, scripts/agent_cycle.py check or next, renderer, benchmark, or native tool was run.
Remote pinned-source review cannot inspect local worktree status, uncommitted changes or local branch state.
Actual CI artifacts and Metal backend routing/execution were explicitly excluded and remain other reviewers' responsibility.
This bounded review does not establish milestone acceptance, physical rendering fidelity or release readiness.
Only the declared source/test files and startup/contract documentation were reviewed; no source, tree, commit or ref was changed.
conclusion: No concrete defect found in the assigned parity metrics, invalid-mask and malformed-buffer scope. Source semantics and existing regression cases align with the dated code acceptance contract.
